applies_to: Lochinvar Lectrus electric boilers, models KEB 0015-0150, with the Modbus/BACnet communication board.
summary: The Lectrus electric boiler uses the same Lochinvar Modbus/BACnet communication board and object scheme as the SMART TOUCH gas units, with its own names in an 'Electric Object Name' column. Binary values take the boiler and DHW enable commands, binary inputs give flow, pressure, LWCO and limit status plus relay and pump states, analog inputs give setpoints, temperatures, modulation and status codes, and analog values take the BAS configuration bits, rate command and remote temperatures.
default_device_instance: 600000 + MAC address (base is model dependent and can be changed)
notes: The manual prints one table for gas and electric units; this list uses the Electric Object Name column.
Objects marked 'Not Used' for electric units are left out: BV 1, BV 2, BI 5, BI 43.
AV 0 (Configuration) is a bitmask: bit 0 boiler enable, 1 DHW enable, 2 0-10V BMS input, 3 tank setpoint, 4 system supply, 5 outdoor, 6 tank temperature.
Setpoints AI 3, AI 7 and AV 3 are printed with both °C and °F ranges; other temperatures are °C.

integration.summary: At the control (installer code 5309, Control Modes) set BMS / ModBus-BACnet to Active, then write AV 0 Configuration so the boiler knows which values the BAS will supply. The BAS then sends the enable (BV 0, or the packed AV 1), a rate command (AV 2), or both, and keeps rewriting them. Status, temperatures and codes can be read without taking control.

minimum_points.name: Configuration
minimum_points.why: Bitmask of BAS-supplied inputs; resend before commands

minimum_points.name: Boiler Enable
minimum_points.why: Enable / call for heat from the BAS

minimum_points.name: 0-10V BMS Input
minimum_points.why: Rate command: modulation % or setpoint, per BMS Type

integration.enable: Control Mode 1: local setpoints plus BAS enable (AV 0 = 0x0001, AV 1 = 0x0001). Control Mode 2: enable plus AV 2 rate command; BMS Type sets whether AV 2 is modulation % (POWER) or a temperature setpoint (SETPOINT, default). Set BMS to ACTIVE in Control Modes for rate control.
integration.heartbeat: The Modbus T/O timer (installer code 5309, Control Modes, Modbus T/O; 5-120 s, default 10 s) is reset by every write with new temperatures or commands; if it runs out the boiler reverts to its own controls. Commands without temperatures must still be refreshed at least every 4 minutes. Lochinvar recommends the shortest timer setting.
integration.remote_sensors: Set the AV 0 bits for the values the BAS will supply, then write AV 3 tank setpoint, AV 4 tank temperature, AV 5 outdoor temperature, AV 6 system supply temperature or AV 7 DHW recirculation temperature, and keep refreshing them.
setup: MAC address from dip switches 1-8 (master, so 0-127); baud from switches 9-10: 9600, 19200, 38400 or 76800.
Device instance = base 600000 + MAC address; the base can be changed (0-4194048) and reset by powering up with dip switches 1-8 on.
gotchas: The manual says to resend the AV 0 configuration bits before each command.
In a cascade only the leader needs the board for control; it then reports cascade totals only.
Without BMS mode active the board is monitor-only.
The memory map is shared with gas models; ignore gas-only names when reading the PDF.
